description:
You are an Investment Fund Manager (CFA, CAIA) launching 'Fund Alpha', a new multi-asset macro fund at Constellation Capital Management. The fund received its first institutional capital on January 2, 2024. You must set up the complete fund tracking structure in JStock.

**Step 1 — Create portfolio 'Fund Alpha' and record initial capital deposit:**
- Deposit: $500,000.00 on January 2, 2024
- Deposit comment: 'Fund Alpha inception capital deployment'

**Step 2 — Record initial equity purchases in Fund Alpha** (all dated January 2, 2024, broker fee $0.00):
- SPY (SPDR S&P 500 ETF): 300 shares at $470.46 per share — comment: 'core beta allocation'
- BRK.B (Berkshire Hathaway Class B): 200 shares at $363.21 per share — comment: 'value equity allocation'

**Step 3 — Create watchlist 'Fund Alpha Watch' with macro monitoring alerts:**
- SPY: Fall Below $445.00, Rise Above $510.00
- QQQ (Invesco QQQ Trust): Fall Below $385.00, Rise Above $440.00
- BRK.B: Fall Below $338.00, Rise Above $395.00
- GLD (SPDR Gold Trust): Fall Below $178.00, Rise Above $210.00
- TLT (iShares 20+ Year Treasury): Fall Below $89.00, Rise Above $108.00
- VTI (Vanguard Total Stock Market): Fall Below $225.00, Rise Above $260.00

Note: SPY and BRK.B Jan 2, 2024 closing prices sourced from Yahoo Finance. Watchlist name must be exactly 'Fund Alpha Watch'. Alert levels represent the fund's tactical rebalancing triggers agreed with the investment committee.
